name: PocketOS 2.2
notes: Today: weather, your next alarm, lists and latest note on one calm screen.
Lock screen shows the date, next alarm and weather — and holding the back button records a voice note without unlocking.
Quiet hours, Find my Pocket, and a Home layout you arrange in Companion.
Settings are grouped, with a new Battery & storage page.
Books open faster and your reading progress shows in Companion.
